0022600152.text: The Timberwolves (4-2, third in the Northwest and sixth in the West) are on a four-game... wait, let me restate that accurately: Minnesota (4-2, on a W1 streak and 2-1 on the road) visits the Spurs (3-2, on a W3 streak and 2-0 on the road), who sit eighth in the West and fourth in the Southwest, two games back. In their previous meetings, the Timberwolves won 2-1 in the 2025-26 regular season and lost 2-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 139-109 loss in Minneapolis on May 15, 2026, and no games have been played yet in 2026-27. Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), while Rudy Gobert is day-to-day with back spasms and a game-time decision; San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain), with Stephon Castle day-to-day with a mild head injury and also a game-time decision.
